membership_types_time_rules.name: membership_types_time_rules
membership_types_time_rules.value: "membership_types"."kind" <> 'time' or ("membership_types"."duration_months" between 1 and 36 and "membership_types"."visit_count" is null and "membership_types"."validity_days" is null)

membership_types_pack_rules.name: membership_types_pack_rules
membership_types_pack_rules.value: "membership_types"."kind" not in ('visits', 'classes') or ("membership_types"."visit_count" between 1 and 500 and ("membership_types"."validity_days" is null or "membership_types"."validity_days" between 1 and 730) and "membership_types"."duration_months" is null and "membership_types"."max_freeze_days" = 0)

membership_types_day_pass_rules.name: membership_types_day_pass_rules
membership_types_day_pass_rules.value: "membership_types"."kind" <> 'day_pass' or ("membership_types"."duration_months" is null and "membership_types"."visit_count" is null and "membership_types"."validity_days" is null and "membership_types"."max_freeze_days" = 0)

memberships_kind_rules.name: memberships_kind_rules
memberships_kind_rules.value: ("memberships"."kind" <> 'time' or "memberships"."base_ends_on" is not null) and ("memberships"."kind" = 'time' or "memberships"."visits_total" is not null)

memberships_dates_valid.name: memberships_dates_valid
memberships_dates_valid.value: ("memberships"."base_ends_on" is null or "memberships"."base_ends_on" >= "memberships"."starts_on") and ("memberships"."ends_on" is null) = ("memberships"."base_ends_on" is null) and ("memberships"."ends_on" is null or "memberships"."ends_on" >= "memberships"."base_ends_on")

check_ins_visit_consumed_valid.name: check_ins_visit_consumed_valid
check_ins_visit_consumed_valid.value: not "check_ins"."visit_consumed" or ("check_ins"."valid" and "check_ins"."membership_id" is not null)

plans_status_ts_chk.name: plans_status_ts_chk
plans_status_ts_chk.value: ("plans"."status" = 'archived') = ("plans"."archived_at" is not null) and ("plans"."status" <> 'active' or "plans"."activated_at" is not null)

plan_exercises_reps_chk.name: plan_exercises_reps_chk
plan_exercises_reps_chk.value:
("plan_exercises"."reps_min" is null and "plan_exercises"."reps_max" is null)
        or (not "plan_exercises"."to_failure" and "plan_exercises"."reps_min" is not null and "plan_exercises"."reps_max" is not null and "plan_exercises"."reps_min" between 1 and 100 and "plan_exercises"."reps_max" between 1 and 100 and "plan_exercises"."reps_min" <= "plan_exercises"."reps_max")

plan_exercises_weight_chk.name: plan_exercises_weight_chk
plan_exercises_weight_chk.value: "plan_exercises"."weight_kg" is null or ("plan_exercises"."weight_kg" between 0 and 999.75 and "plan_exercises"."weight_kg" * 4 = trunc("plan_exercises"."weight_kg" * 4))

workout_sets_weight_chk.name: workout_sets_weight_chk
workout_sets_weight_chk.value: "workout_sets"."weight_kg" is null or ("workout_sets"."weight_kg" between 0 and 999.75 and "workout_sets"."weight_kg" * 4 = trunc("workout_sets"."weight_kg" * 4))

workout_sets_values_chk.name: workout_sets_values_chk
workout_sets_values_chk.value:
("workout_sets"."measure" = 'weight_reps' and "workout_sets"."reps" is not null and "workout_sets"."weight_kg" is not null and "workout_sets"."duration_seconds" is null)
        or ("workout_sets"."measure" = 'reps' and "workout_sets"."reps" is not null and "workout_sets"."weight_kg" is null and "workout_sets"."duration_seconds" is null)
        or ("workout_sets"."measure" = 'duration' and "workout_sets"."duration_seconds" is not null and "workout_sets"."reps" is null and "workout_sets"."weight_kg" is null)
